items.title: File Widerspruch against Krankengeld denial
items.quote: Widerspruch gegen diesen Bescheid kann innerhalb eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei der Muster BKK erhoben werden.
items.computation: Letter dated Tue 27.01.2026, sent by simple post. Per the letter's own clause and current § 37 Abs. 2 SGB X, a notice sent by ordinary post is deemed received on the 4th day after posting (day of posting not counted): 28.01 (Wed, day1), 29.01 (Thu, day2), 30.01 (Fri, day3), 31.01 (Sat, day4). Since the 4th day (31.01.2026) falls on a Saturday, established practice (as for the analogous § 122 Abs. 2 AO rule) postpones deemed delivery to the next business day: Monday 02.02.2026 = date of Bekanntgabe. The one-month Widerspruch period runs under §§ 187 Abs. 1, 188 Abs. 2 BGB: the day of Bekanntgabe itself is the reference day, and the period ends one month later on the day bearing the same number, i.e. 02.03.2026 (a Monday, not a NW public holiday), so the deadline stands unchanged.

warnings: The exact date the letter was actually posted/received by the person is not stated; the deemed-delivery date (and thus the Widerspruch deadline) was calculated from the printed letter date (27.01.2026) assuming same-day posting and ordinary mail — verify the envelope postmark or actual receipt date if available, as this could shift the deadline.
No specific Krankengeld amount is stated in the letter; only the start date of payment (ab 22.01.2026) is given.
